fixture_policy: Synthetic contract fixtures only; no live performance, thermal, scan-out or battery claim.

cases.scenario: A renderer looks faster because candidate output pixels or MSAA were reduced.
cases.expected: Changed workload is rejected with exit 3 before aggregation.

cases.scenario: A thermal experiment requests 120 FPS but Chrome draws or native presenter presents only 60.
cases.expected: Actual counters fail; requested-cap source cannot establish proof.

cases.scenario: A tiny mean temperature reduction is smaller than trial-to-trial variation.
cases.expected: Independent-trial variation yields inconclusive, exit 5; one-second readings are not replications.

cases.scenario: GPU time drops because a panel no longer renders or a workflow stopped working.
cases.expected: Failed visual/functional parity invalidates the included trial.

cases.scenario: Before/after runs are interleaved ABAB despite a drifting thermal baseline.
cases.expected: Thermal contract requires full ABBA blocks; generic performance does not mandate ABBA.

cases.scenario: A sensor has no fan or power reading, while measured CPU time improves.
cases.expected: Missing value remains unknown; do not substitute zero or claim all metrics improved.

cases.scenario: A low-FPS calibration is excluded from an otherwise controlled comparison.
cases.expected: Reason and raw hashes remain in the report; excluded trial is not a replication.
